descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S24b 「baseline 问卷对话框、交接后续问题对话框、Settings 反馈和养老院 Post-Round 的任务按钮通过 axe」 Baseline survey dialog, handoff follow-up dialog, Settings feedback and the Nursing Home Post-Round task buttons pass axe

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Immediately after a handoff is sent, an in-app prompt appears asking 'Did having this make you more likely to send a handoff today?' (Yes / No / Not sure), and the answer is stored（UAT OAT-06 Test 4；TFA-94514 AC 3；TFA-94609 Spec 2；TFA-94609 AC 5）
  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2；TFA-94514 AC 4；TFA-94609 AC 7）
  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3；TFA-94514 AC 5；TFA-94609 Spec 3）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15; a fresh account with seeded resident tasks, plus a colleague account for the send

When axe on the open Baseline survey dialog, the handoff follow-up dialog after a send, /settings Feedback, and the Nursing Home Post-Round tab with open tasks

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; both dialogs have accessible names; the rating buttons are a named radio group; Not now, Skip and Send feedback reachable by keyboard; every task button has an accessible name; tap targets >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core violations (serious/critical) = 0 and the name checks from visual-checks.ts. Known from the code read: the Nursing Home Post-Round task buttons (complete, delete) have no accessible name (src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx:298-319)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S24b 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94514 ready for qa；TFA-94609 ready for pr

养老院 Post-Round 任务列表里每个任务的完成和删除按钮都没有名字，VoiceOver 只读「button, button」；问卷的 Yes / Start survey 对比度不够，Handoff 和 Settings 的返回/关闭按钮也没有名字。

On the Nursing Home Post-Round task list each task's complete and delete buttons have no name, so VoiceOver reads only 'button, button'; the survey Yes / Start survey buttons fail contrast and the Handoff and Settings back/close buttons are unnamed.

依据：allure d9dd7696-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24b: 32 checks pass, 14 fail (axe button-name critical on the NH task buttons). Dialog names, the named radio group in Settings Feedback, and Tab reach for Not now / Skip / Send feedback pass. Recorded: the survey answer chips are not exposed as radio groups.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：visual。

Plus contrast (white on teal Yes / Start survey) and the unnamed back/close buttons on the Handoff and Settings screens.
